title: Stop Applying Online | How to Land a Job in the Hidden Job Market
description:
Stop Applying Online | How to Land a Job in the Hidden Job Market


The average UK job role gets 140 applications. Around 32% of postings on sites like Indeed aren't even real. And the candidates getting hired aren't beating that pile, they're skipping it. About 75% of jobs never get posted publicly. That is the hidden job market.

This video breaks down exactly where those hidden jobs are, why mass applying stopped working in 2026, and the 3 step system one of my clients used to go from 200 applications and 0 offers to landing an analyst role at JP Morgan.


What you'll learn in this video:
- Why 86% of recruiters reject candidates on communication, not skills (survey of 500 recruiters)
- The credential inflation problem that makes your degree weaker than it used to be
- How to access the 75% of UK jobs that never get posted online (the hidden job market)
- The LinkedIn alumni method that gets a 22% reply rate from decision makers
- The 3 step system to build your personal brand, network, and land interviews without applying
